title: Hereditary Beast Transformation Disorder
text: “Now then……”
Father, having taken custody of the slaves, stepped out of the monster merchant’s tent and made his way around to the back, where the envoys from Siltvelt stood waiting.
“Hero-sama, um……these people are?”
“They’re the ones who’ll fill our sideshow slots for the circus. From the right, Theodore, Sion, and Wolf. Well, I figure I’ll raise them up properly too, among other things.”
“I see……how fortunate for them. All of you, that fortune will last a lifetime, you know.”
The Siltvelt envoy tilted their head slightly as their gaze lingered on the wolf man.
“Doesn’t look like there’s a slave trader around……phew.”
Father dropped the act with a tired sigh and turned a smile toward the three slaves.

“Anyway, from here on out, I’m Naofumi Iwatani, your master. Circumstances have led me into the slave trade and the circus business. I intend to keep you out of the sideshow lineup as much as I possibly can.”

According to Father, he privately hated the idea of putting people on display, since he himself had once been falsely accused and paraded as a spectacle by the kingdom’s lot. Quite right too. We had, of course, quietly disposed of the soldiers who’d enjoyed that particular spectacle in secret.
“If you try to make a fool of me too much, I’ll punish you accordingly, but if you follow instructions, I’ll promise you a certain amount of freedom.”
The notion of freeing slaves isn’t exactly encouraged by this world’s standards, I say. Foolishly, I once pressed Father to free Big Sister.
“Motoyasu-kun says he’s worked things out with the Filolials.”
“Is that so? On our end, the carriages are ready as well. Shall we depart at once, then?”
“Yeah, I’ve got the map of candidate sites too, so we’ll travel while holding practice performances along the way.”

In the meantime, we’d be leveling up those who looked promising as fighting strength, I suspected. Father, as if just to pass the time, reached out and stroked the face of the wolf man, Wolf, who stood quietly waiting.
“Kuun.”
Wolf had looked rather displeased at first, but as the petting continued, his nose twitched and his eyes narrowed in obvious pleasure.
Father has no attack power, after all, indeed. The Filolial-samas themselves had said his fur never snags painfully or anything like that. He really is remarkably skilled at grooming.

“I suppose we’ll have to wait for Raphtalia-chan and the others to recover their stamina too……when we do the slave trading, I’ll need them to check on the village children, and besides that there’s the job of buying other slaves and delivering them to the slave traders too……”

Apparently, while running the circus, he’d also be transporting slaves on behalf of the nobility. Among the slaves in transit, the plan was to search out and buy back Big Sister’s village children. Of course, he’d also buy other slaves alongside them so as not to arouse suspicion, or so the story went.
“Anyway, once preparations are done, let’s head out. Staying too close to the capital won’t earn us much.”
“Understood, indeed.”
“Very well.”
And so, bringing Kuro-chan and the others along, we formed a caravan of countless wagons and set off.
The next day, indeed. Kuro-chan and the others were pulling a great many wagons, but with so many, our pace was rather leisurely. We needed to secure food along the way, I say.
“A hereditary disease, huh……”
Father kept checking the rabbit man’s arm over and over.

“I wondered what kind of hereditary disease rabbits get……but I’m not too familiar with this stuff. I thought maybe it was something like a dislocated hip, but if it’s just the right arm, it seems mild.”
It was bent at a strange angle, after all.
“At a glance, it looks kind of like a broken bone that healed without being set properly. What exactly is this hereditary disease, Theodore?”
Father asked the rabbit man. In response, the rabbit man tensed his arm, and……part of it transformed into beast form. But the joint bent at an even stranger angle.
“Gh……th-this is a disease where……fur grows regardless of conscious will, and the joints end up bending the opposite way from how I intend.”

I later heard from the monster merchant that this was called Hereditary Beast Transformation Disorder. Apparently, a malfunction occurs in the factor within a demi-human’s genes responsible for beast transformation, and when the skeletal change happens, part of the body remains human and ends up fractured, fixed at a strange angle. This apparently happens even unconsciously, leaving the joints unable to bend as intended, or something along those lines, I say. What’s more, this rabbit man apparently lacked sufficient aptitude for beast transformation, and the troublesome symptom of only part of his body changing was what caused this problem in the first place.
“So it’s a disease unique to the races of another world……”

Still, it seemed to be something that could be overcome to a degree through chiropractic care as control gradually improved. Or perhaps, I surmised, it was the kind of disease one could overcome by growing as a companion of the Heroes.
“I see……still, if he just leaves it unused, it’ll probably get worse, so some light adjustment seems like a good idea.”
With that, Father worked the rabbit man’s stiff joint, bending it as gently as he could manage without causing pain.

“Yeah. The muscle’s stiff. First, let’s stretch it to loosen things up here……it’ll be a bit forceful, but I’m going to break the bone once and set it properly. Motoyasu-kun, I’ll need your healing magic ready for that.”
“Understood.”

Father still couldn’t use magic on his own, after all. I resolved to scrape together some funds later and buy Father a spellbook and other equipment to make casting magic easier for him. Physical items were far less likely to draw suspicion, I say. At a glance, it might have looked like Father was applying some kind of joint lock technique, but since the Shield wasn’t reacting, it was surely well within the bounds of chiropractic treatment.
“Theodore, how is it? Still hurt?”
“No……it feels just right.”
Father seemed to be kneading the stiff spots in the rabbit man’s arm just enough to loosen the muscle. The rabbit man’s eyes narrowed as though he found it quite pleasant.
“Kuun……”
Wolf let out a sound at Father, who was in the middle of this treatment.
“If I may ask Father something, have you perhaps picked up chiropractic skills from a part-time job or the like?”
“Huh? Nah, I definitely never learned proper chiropractic care. Well, I do know enough trivia to tell the difference between a chiropractic clinic and a simple massage parlor, though.”
Oh my, so that wasn’t it. The technique had looked rather polished, so I’d assumed he had some sort of professional experience in that line of work.
“Then what makes you judge it that way, I wonder?”
“Don’t you learn about setting broken bones and stretching in health class at school? Thinking back on that, this is really just half-baked chiropractic work.”
It might not be the best method, but still, Father said, somewhat self-deprecatingly.
“After this, I think drying out some medicinal herbs to brew and doing moxibustion or acupuncture would probably be good too.”
I vaguely recalled Father doing something similar to a rabbit man he’d bought during one of his loops before. That the same idea would occur to him again really was just so like Father.
“My relative, an old man, used to do moxibustion. As for acupuncture, I saw it in a manga once and got interested, so I had someone knowledgeable teach me a bit about the pressure points.”

It’s all pretty shallow knowledge, really, Father said self-deprecatingly as he administered the treatment to the rabbit man. Incidentally, acupuncture needles were sold in the market, and when Father put one into the Shield, an acupuncture skill appeared, which he then used on the rabbit man.
“Given that it’s ‘needles,’ and needles make me think of spears, Motoyasu-kun would probably be better at this than me.”
“Of course needles fall well within my domain as a spear user, indeed! So shall I take over? Why, I could turn this very rabbit man into a pincushion, I say!”
“Hiii!?”

The rabbit man let out a frightened squeal. Fear not, I say. This Motoyasu shall skewer your entire body through and through and somehow still leave you alive at the end of it. Behold this convenient acupuncture technique, whereby the pressure points are revealed by the power of my weapon, just like the marks shown for where to strike with a pickaxe while mining!
